intendedAction: Record direct operator screenshot observation of the actual popup-mediated clearance approval modal and classify whether it satisfies FP-MCP-269 human-attention requirements.
notes: Operator supplied screenshots of the actual forgepilot_create_operator_local_execution_clearance approval modal on mobile.

The modal summary includes that it creates a short-lived operator-local execution clearance artifact, names workspace forgepilot, shows commit 2ad7ad1, states no execution is started, and says only a local clearance file is written.

The modal does not visibly show the complete FP-MCP-269 required tuple in the main visible approval surface, including requestId, approvalPacketId, modelId, runMode, executionBaseCommit, requestArtifactCommit distinction, branch, expiry countdown, or all explicit side-effect fields.
The modal includes Deny, Allow once, and Always allow. Always allow is not acceptable for clearance-creating tools under FP-MCP-269.
The operator declined the tool path; no clearance was created.
recoveryAction: Record FP-MCP-271 as partial-compliance/platform-limitation evidence before FP-027 planning.
observationSemantics: operator workflow trace is control-plane evidence, not model-performance evidence
